_doc: Research tree. min_base_level: the node also needs a base at that level (any district; the garden robots wait for the Depot Station). [money] Costs Cubes plus real time: x10 the old Data cost, x25 for the frontier tiers 6-7 (late cubes are plentiful; Data used to be the late gate). Field notes (data_rewards: cleaning hexes, blooms, restored hexes, memory shards, robot work) pay note_cubes cubes each, which is exactly what the old Data was worth, so research paces as before. tier = row in the graph (0 top), branch = column. requires = node ids that must be researched (lines are drawn from them). time_s = real seconds; research continues offline. effects: {stat, mode add|mul_pct, amount} applies through Economy.stat; {unlock_robot}; {unlock_plant}; {flag} = a capability other systems check with Research.has(id).

nodes.name: Scoop Beam
nodes.desc: A soft blue guide beam on the scoop. Lumi reaches a little further.

nodes.name: Wide Beam
nodes.desc: Spread the beam into a fan. Each sweep catches more.

nodes.name: Bigger Hopper
nodes.desc: Fold-out side panels for the chest compartment.

nodes.name: Auto-Sort
nodes.desc: A little sorting comb in the intake. Cleaner bales sell for more.

nodes.name: Field Magnet
nodes.desc: Loose bits hop toward the scoop on their own.

nodes.name: Tractor Beam
nodes.desc: Junk lifts, floats and glides into the hopper. It is very satisfying.

nodes.name: Salvage Logic
nodes.desc: Lumi rewrites the base's old assembly logic. The base can build helpers again: Scoopies, Haul Bugs and Skimmers.

nodes.name: Seedling Blueprint
nodes.desc: Plans for a small planter bot. Build it at the workbench.

nodes.name: Drip Blueprint
nodes.desc: A watering bot with a sloshy tank. Plants will love it.

nodes.name: Bale Tuning
nodes.desc: Tighter presses on every Scoopie. Bigger, denser bales.

nodes.name: Multibot Blueprint
nodes.desc: A helper that can clean, plant or water. Jack of all trades.

nodes.name: Swarm Sync
nodes.desc: The whole fleet shares one little heartbeat. Everyone moves faster.

nodes.name: Soil Survey
nodes.desc: Sniff, poke, log. Every reading teaches Lumi something.

nodes.name: Hardy Nettles
nodes.desc: Nettles grow anywhere. Stingy, stubborn, and good for the soil.

nodes.name: Wild Mint
nodes.desc: A fresh green smell drifts over the cleared hexes.

nodes.name: Pollinator Survey
nodes.desc: Count the visitors. The bees are back: every plant grows much faster, blooms drop more seeds, and Seedlings learn where flowers want to be.

nodes.name: Hedgerows
nodes.desc: Dense little hedges. Birds will need somewhere to sit. Gardens grow a little faster again.

nodes.name: Evergreen Saplings
nodes.desc: Tiny pines. In a hundred years, a forest. Blooms drop more seeds.

nodes.name: Water Testing
nodes.desc: Dip strips and a lot of squinting. The lakes are sick, not dead.

nodes.name: Big Tanks
nodes.desc: Drip and Multibot carry more water per trip.

nodes.name: Spray Heads
nodes.desc: A misting nozzle. Water bots reach further and work faster.

nodes.name: Silt Filters
nodes.desc: Layered sand and charcoal. Murky water turns glassy.

nodes.name: Pump Lines
nodes.desc: Hoses from the lake to the hub. Water bots refill faster.

nodes.name: Irrigation
nodes.desc: Buried drip lines. The meadow drinks while you sleep.

nodes.name: Field Notebook
nodes.desc: Lumi starts keeping tidy notes. Research goes a bit quicker.

nodes.name: Conveyor Belts
nodes.desc: Rollers salvaged from an old shop till. Bales can ride to the scale.

nodes.name: Auto-Baler
nodes.desc: A hub station that presses loose junk into bales by itself.

nodes.name: Haul Routes
nodes.desc: Painted lines on the ground. Haul Bugs stop bumping into each other.

nodes.name: Recycler
nodes.desc: Grind bales back into clean stock. Junk gone for good.

nodes.name: Rocket Cargo
nodes.desc: Cargo pods for the rocket. Hubs can trade with each other.

nodes.name: Observatory Optics
nodes.desc: Ground lenses from an old planetarium and a crew telemetry link. Any base can build a Telescope (without it, from base level 4) and watch the crews on other worlds.

nodes.name: Dune Charts
nodes.desc: Wind maps and landing beacons for the far deserts. The rocket can reach the Dust Flats (with two bases at level 5).

nodes.name: Thermal Lance
nodes.desc: A heat coil wound round the beam. Lumi melts ice twice as fast, and the rocket can land at the Frozen Port.

nodes.name: Heat Pumps
nodes.desc: Heaters pull warmth out of the frozen harbour itself. They thaw faster and warm their neighbours more.

nodes.name: Dune Fences
nodes.desc: Brush fences and hedges that break the wind. Sustained hexes shelter two rings around them, and sandstorms carry less.

nodes.name: Cold-Hardy Seeds
nodes.desc: Seeds bred from the few things that survived the cold. Ferns, nettles, pines, periwinkle and frost moss can grow outdoors at the Frozen Port.

nodes.name: Dew Condensers
nodes.desc: Cold fins on every Water Tank pull water out of the night air. Tanks refill much faster where the ground is dry.

nodes.name: Pump Works
nodes.desc: Plans for the old city pumps. The rocket can reach the Sunken City, and Skimmers net faster.

nodes.name: Ark Beacon
nodes.desc: A landing beacon tuned to the Cradle. Once the three frontiers are thriving, it calls the ark home.
